newsitem.title: EU: REUTER EUROPEAN COURT OF JUSTICE DIARY FOR TUESDAY, DECEMBER 3 - THURSDAY, DECEMBER 12.
newsitem.headline: REUTER EUROPEAN COURT OF JUSTICE DIARY FOR TUESDAY, DECEMBER 3 - THURSDAY, DECEMBER 12.

text.p: TUESDAY, DECEMBER 3

COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-268/94 Portugal v/ Council: external relations. Annulment of Council decision 94/578 of July 18, 1994, on the conclusion of the co-operation accord between the EU and the Indian Republic on partnership and development. Judicial basis: EC treaty article 113 and 130 Y, in combination with article 228, paragraph 2, first phrase and paragraph 3, third line. Failure to achieve unanimity required by article 235. - Opinion C-336/94 Dafeki: free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty articles 6, 48 and 51. Probative force of national documents relating to civil status. Establishment of birth date for purposes of determining old age pension. - Oral procedure C-345/95 France v/ Parliament: company law. Annulment of European Parliament deliberation of September 20, 1995, fixing the 1996 work calendar (providing for only 11 Strasbourg sittings). Breach of Edinburgh decision on institution headquarters. Substantial breach of due form. - (1030/0930 GMT) Oral procedure C-395/95-P Geotronics v/ Commission: external relations. Appeal against Court judgment (fourth chamber) of October 26, 1995, in case T-185/94, Geotronics v/ Commission. Annulment of Commission decision of March 10, 1994, on a contract originally accorded by the Romanian government following a tendering by the Commission in the framework of the Phare programme.
WEDNESDAY, DECEMBER 4

COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0830 GMT) - Oral procedure C-70/95 Sodemare: free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty articles 52, 58 and 59. National law on exploitation of retirement homes. Social services reserved for non-profit-making organisations. Public funding of services.

COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, FOURTH CHAMBER (enlarged) (0930/0830 GMT) - Oral procedure T-47/95 Terres Rouges v/ Commission: agriculture. Annulment of Commission regulation 3224/94 of December 21, 1994, laying down temporary measures for the implementation of a framework agreement on bananas concluded in the context of the Uruguay round multilateral trade negociations.
THURSDAY, DECEMBER 5

COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment joined cases C-267/95, C-268/95 Merck: membership of new states. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 47 of the 1985 membership act. Date of end of application on pharmaceutical products imported from or marketed in Spain or Portugal. Interpretation of EC treaty articles 30 and 36. Right of the holder of a patent registered in a member state to oppose the import by a third party of this same product in a country where it was marketed for the first time after community membership but at a time when the product patent could not be obtained. - Opinion C-357/95-P ENU v/ Commission: funding. Appeal against Court judgment (second chamber enlarged), rendered September 15, 1995, in cases T-458/93 and T-523/93, ENU v/ Commission. EAEC treaty. Uranium production consumption.

SECOND CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion C-246/95 Coen: company law. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty article 173, fifth line. Delay of action. Possible reopening of a deadline following a national judicial decision acknowledging the irregularity of an act under national authority that may have influenced an act that may have been subject to an action under EC treaty article 173. Regularity of a Commission recruitment procedure for temporary agents through a call for candidatures submitted to the permanent delegations of various member state.

FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-e5/95 Reisdorf: taxation. Request for preliminary ruling. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 18, paragraph 1 (a) of sixth Council VAT directive 77/388/EEC of May 17, 1977, on the harmonisation of member states' legislation on turnover tax. Common VAT system: uniform basis of assessment. Deduction of taxes paid upstream. Required invoice. Notion. Copies, duplicates or photocopies. - Opinion C-103/96 Eridania Beghin-Say: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Validity of article 9 of Council regulation 3677/86 of November 24, 1986, setting down certain application provisions for regulation 1999/85 on inward processing relief arrangements. Equivalency in compensation mechanisms. Cane and beet root sugars. - Opinion C-205/96 Commission v/ Belgium: approximation of legislation. Non respect. Failure to have transposed within the prescribed period Council directive 92/42/EEC of May 21, 1992, on output requirements for new combustible liquid or gas hot water boilers. - Oral procedure C-258/95 Julius Fillibeck Soehne: taxation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 2, point 1 and 6, paragraph 2 of sixth Council VAT directive 77/388/EEC of May 17, 1977, on the harmonisation of member states' legislation on turnover tax. Common VAT system: uniform basis of assessment. Services effected for payment. Use of property designated for company use. Offering of a service performed by taxable party for the private needs of his staff. Free home-to-job worker transport provided by employer in accordance with a collective convention. - (1030/0930 GMT) Oral procedure C-153/96-P de Rijk v/ Commission: statute of officials. Appeal against Court judgment rendered March 7, 1996 in case T-362/94,, Rijk v/ Commission. Annulment of the decision refusing the repayment of the difference between medical costs presented for a covered child who normally resides in an EU country and the sum repaid under a general policy.

SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-69/95 Italy v/ Commission: agriculture. Partial annulment of decision on the clearance of the accounts presented by member states in respect of expenditure for 1991 of the EAGGF, Guarantee Section. Expenditure for the acquisition of milk quotas for their redistribution to other producers. - Judgment C-91/96 Commission v/ Greece: agriculture. Non respect. Failure to have transposed within the prescribed period Council directive 92/118/EEC of December 17, 1992, laying down animal health and public health requirements governing trade in and imports into the Community of products not subject to the said requirements laid down in specific Community rules referred to in Annex A(I) to directive 89/662/EEC and, as regards pathogens, to directive 90/425/EEC and of Council directive 93/52/EEC of June 24, 1993, amending directive 89/556/EEC laying down animal health and public health requirements governing trade in and imports into the Community from third countries of domestic animal embryos of the bovine species. - Oral procedure C-8/96 Locamion: taxation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of articles 4, 7, 10 and 12 of Council directive 69/335/EEC of July 17, 1969, on indirect taxes on the raising of capital. National law maintaining a registration duty on the merger of companies and providing for a tax on the transfer of certain goods (vehicle pool) incurred in a merger. Vehicle rental company. Car tax on the vehicles. - (1000/0900 GMT) Oral procedure C-136/95 Thibault: social policy. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of articles 1, paragraph 1, 2, paragraph 1 and 4 and 5, paragraph 1 of Council directive 76/207/EEC of February 9, 1976, on the implementation of the principle of equal treatment for men and women as regards access to jobs, job training and promotion and working conditions. Collective convention under which maternity leave automatically causes loss of chances for promotion.
